title: 第749章 查隐藏修为不好意思我是纯正的金丹期第748章 生死时差化神封城极限金蝉脱壳
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
逼仄的客栈里透着散不去的木头霉味。
林渊盘膝坐在木板床上。
化神老怪封城，等同于焊死了他所有的退路。
若是现在强闯，对上化神期绝对十死无生。
腰间的传讯玉简亮起微光。
林渊随手布下隔音禁制，神识探入其中。
“道友，可否出来一叙？”
苏瑶的声音透着焦急与慌乱。
林渊起身推门。
隐入夜色。
一炷香后。
一处隐秘的会客室内。
苏瑶换了身灰布麻衣，正在走来走去，眼底带着红血丝。
看到林渊进入，她几步迎了上来。
“道友，你可知这护城大阵究竟要封锁到何时？”
她声音压得很低，透着绝望。
林渊摇了摇头。
“那化神神君行事百无禁忌，谁敢去触他的霉头？”
苏瑶绞着衣角，指节泛白。
“可是……我们等不起啊！”

她语速极快。
“我族姐刚传讯来，那隐秘洞府里的婴灵果，就在这三五日内便要彻底成熟！”
“若是错过了采摘时机，果熟蒂落，灵气波动必定掩盖不住。”
“到时候，满东荒域的老怪物闻着味儿扑过去，咱们连口汤都喝不上！”
破局的机缘就在眼前，却被困在坊市里。
“你族姐那头，可有门路弄到出城的路引？”林渊问。
苏瑶苦笑着摇头。
“别说路引了，眼下连谢家自己的核心子弟都严禁外出。”
两人在破庙里商议了半晌，毫无头绪。
“罢了，走一步看一步。若真出不去，那也是命。”
林渊甩下一句话，转身离开。
回到客栈房间。
林渊一拍须弥纳戒，那块花天价买来的五阶下品“星核铁”砸在桌面上。
空冥石、界影尘、须弥晶等极品辅助材料依次排开。
借着残存的四阶阵旗掩盖气机，他十指翻飞。
《太虚万阵图》在识海中推演，阵纹被剥离重构。
金丹真火自指尖跃出，将星核铁包裹。
高温炙烤下，星核铁逐渐软化，黑色杂质被强行淬炼而出。
就在林渊炼制阵盘之时。
西陵坊市上空，云层翻滚。

一道紫金色的流光撕裂护城大阵的光幕，砸落在坊市中心的城主府内。
来人正是谢镇山。
他满头大汗，紫金长袍沾染着尘土，神色惊恐。
城主府大殿内。
content_en:
The cramped inn had a lingering musty smell of wood.
Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on the wooden bed.
Transforming the old monster into a god and sealing off the city is equivalent to welding all his escape routes.
If he forced his way in now, he would definitely be dead in the transformation stage.
The jade message slip on his waist shimmered.
Lin Yuan casually set up a soundproof barrier and penetrated it with his spiritual consciousness.
"Fellow Taoist, can you come out and talk?"
Su Yao's voice was anxious and panicked.
Lin Yuan stood up and opened the door.
Disappear into the night.
After a stick of incense.
A secret reception room.
Su Yao changed into gray cloth and linen clothes and was walking around with red bloodshot eyes.
Seeing Lin Yuan enter, she took a few steps to greet him.
"Fellow Taoist, do you know how long this city defense formation will be sealed off?"
Her voice was low and full of desperation.
Lin Yuan shook his head.
"The Transformation God Lord has no taboos in his actions. Who dares to get into trouble with him?"
Su Yao twisted her clothes and her knuckles turned white.
"But... we can't afford to wait!"
She spoke very fast.
"My clan sister has just sent word that the Infant Spirit Fruit in the secret cave will be completely mature within these three to five days!"
"If the picking time is missed, the fruit will fall off when ripe, and the spiritual energy fluctuations will not be able to cover it up."
"When the time comes, the old monsters from the Eastern Wasteland will smell the smell and pounce on us, and we won't even be able to drink the soup!"
The opportunity to break the situation is right in front of you, but you are trapped in the city.
"Does your clan sister have a way to get a way out of the city?" Lin Yuan asked.
Su Yao smiled bitterly and shook her head.
"Forget Lu Yin, even the Xie family's own core children are strictly prohibited from going out."
The two of them discussed it in the ruined temple for a long time without any clue.
"That's all, just take it one step at a time. If you really can't get out, it's your fate."
Lin Yuan said a few words and turned to leave.
Return to the inn room.
Lin Yuan slapped the Xumina Ring, and the fifth-grade low-grade "Star Core Iron" bought at a sky-high price smashed on the table.
The best auxiliary materials such as Kongming Stone, Jie Yingchen, Xumi Crystal, etc. are lined up in sequence.
Using the remaining fourth-order formation flag to cover up his energy, his fingers flew.
"Taixu Ten Thousand Formations Diagram" is deduced in the sea of ​​consciousness, and the formation patterns are peeled off and reconstructed.
The golden elixir true fire jumped out from the fingertips and wrapped the star core iron.
Under the high temperature, the star core iron gradually softens, and the black impurities are forcibly quenched out.
Just when Lin Yuan was refining the formation disk.
Over Xilingfang City, clouds rolled.
A stream of purple-gold light tore through the light curtain of the city defense formation and fell on the city lord's palace in the center of the city.
The person who came was none other than Xie Zhenshan.
He was sweating profusely, his purple and gold robes were stained with dust, and his expression was horrified.
In the main hall of the city lord's mansion.
